title: Etale object models stable under pointed open refinement
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, any scheme $S$, and a finite family $L_a$ of lisse rational modules [def-sfb-monodromy-realization-data]. There is an etale covering family $Y_i\to S$ such that for every open immersion $g:T\to Y_i$, every pointed connected qcqs topologically Noetherian datum $p$ on $T$, and every normalized realization $R$ for $p$, there are representations $V_a$ and isomorphisms $R(V_a)\cong(g\circ Y_i\to S)^{-1}L_a$. Restriction is the slice-site presheaf restriction with identity continuous-function coefficient comparison. The assertion concerns only objects, with no arrows; ranks may be zero and the finite family may be empty.

source.place: Definition 6.8.3, Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4),(6), pp. 59–60, and the integral-monodromy reduction in the proof of Corollary 6.8.5, p. 60. The exact-realization formulation makes the comparison used in that proof explicit; it does not assert closure of all pro-étale lisse sheaves.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-monodromy-single-object-cover] separately to every object. Form the family of all etale objects equipped with a map to one member of each chosen cover. For every test object the sieve this family generates contains the intersection of the finitely many covering sieves; the finite intersection is covering by induction. This proves the common family covers, including the empty index set, where the intersection is the top sieve. On a pointed open chart compose with each common refinement map, apply its single-object model, and use the equation in the etale over-category to identify its composite restriction with the chart restriction. Choose the representations pointwise. This argument asserts no lifting of arrows and uses no connected-cover construction.

proof_origin.place: Lean proof: finite intersections of covering sieves give a common covering refinement, and the slice-arrow equation transports each single-object monodromy model.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_sf_monodromy_object_cover (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (S : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [Finite A] (L : A → SfRationalModules l E S)
    (hL : ∀ a : A, (L a).IsFiniteLocallyFree) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Y : I → S.Etale), S.smallEtaleTopology.CoversTop Y ∧
      ∀ (i : I) (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ (Y i).left) [IsOpenImmersion g]
        (p : SfMonodromyPoint T) (R : SfMonodromyRealization l E p),
        ∃ V : A → SfContinuousRepresentations l E p,
          ∀ a : A, Nonempty ((R.functor.obj (V a)).val ≅
            (PresheafOfModules.pushforward
              (ProEtale.lisseEtaleCoefficientIdentificationSized l E (g ≫ (Y i).hom))).obj
                (L a).val)
